title: C482/165/2023 of VIPIN KUMAR Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
SL.
No Date
Office Notes, reports,
orders or proceedings
or directions and
Registrar's order with
Signatures
COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
02.02.2023 C482 No. 165 of 2023
Hon'ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Gaurav Singh, Advocate, for the
applicants.
Mr. Lalit Miglani, AGA, for the State.
Mr. Kamlesh Tiwari, Advocate,
holding brief of Mr. Shariq Khurshid,
Advocate, for the respondent.
The applicant respondent No. 2
herein, on 21.07.2022 had registered an FIR
No. 363 of 2022 as against the present
applicants for their alleged involvement in
the commission of offence under Sections
498A, 323, 504 and 506 of IPC and Section
3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, registered at
P.S. Pathri, district Haridwar.
As a consequence of the
culmination of the investigation, the
Chargesheet No. 1 dated 01.10.2022 has
been submitted by the Investigating Officer,
to which the cognizance have been taken,
resulting into initiation of the proceedings of
Criminal Case No. 762 of 2022, State Vs.
Vipin and others, which is presently pending
consideration before the Court of Additional
Chief Judicial Magistrate, Haridwar, in which
the present applicants have been
summoned by an order dated 25.11.2022.
Apparently, the dispute is
matrimonial in nature and the parties have
settled their dispute in terms of the
Compounding Application (IA/2/2023),

which has been referred to and particularly
in the context of the pleadings raised in para
14 of the Compounding Application, where
the parties have unanimously made a
statement, that the plaintiff as well as the
applicant No. 1, who are the husband and
wife respectively, they are now living
together peacefully and they are discharging
their matrimonial obligations.
In view of the fact, that it is
exclusively a matrimonial dispute, coupled
with the fact, that now the husband and
wife have resolved the controversy and are
living together, which is a statement which
stands fortified by the applicant No. 1 and
the complainant respondent No. 2 herein,
with whom this Court has also interacted
and she has very candidly made a
statement, that owing to the fact, that as
the settlement has taken place between
them, she doesn't intend to prosecute the
present applicants any further, with the
proceedings of the Criminal Case No. 762 of
2022, State Vs. Vipin and others and she
submits that if the said proceedings are
dropped, she may not have any grievances,
as such.
The aforesaid statement of the
applicant respondent No. 2 stands fortified
by the applicant No. 1 and their respective
counsels, who are representing them.
Owing to the aforesaid fact and the
statement made by the complainant and
applicant No. 1, as well as the contents of
the Compounding Application, which has
been verified by them, the present C482
Application would stand allowed, and as a

consequence thereto, the proceedings of
Criminal Case No. 762 of 2022, pending
consideration before the Court of ACJM,
Haridwar, would hereby stand dropped with
an undertaking given by the applicant No. 1,
that henceforth, that he would peacefully
discharge their matrimonial obligation.
Subject to the aforesaid, the present
C482 Application would stand allowed.
(Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
 Vacation Judge
 02.02.2023
Mahinder/
